note: Every legacy site variable maps to a token whose resolved value equals the observed snapshot unless a divergence is recorded. tests/references.test.js enforces this.

--terminal.divergence: D-023: owner-selected true-black canvas; the observed value remains in the heritage profile and historical primitive.

--chrome.divergence: D-023: owner-selected near-black chrome; the historical assignment remains in the heritage profile.

--surface.divergence: D-023: owner-selected near-black panels; the historical assignment remains in the heritage profile.

--surface-raised.divergence: D-027: recessed so an open list reads as depth rather than a lighter panel; the observed value remains in the historical primitive.

--selection.divergence: D-027: recessed selection fill; the check glyph and the 2px indicator carry selection, and the observed value remains in the historical primitive.

--button.divergence: D-026: darkened off heritage ANSI 12, which keeps the observed value and stays fixed in every profile.

--quiet.divergence: D-003: #a3676b measured 4.45:1 as text; text.subtle is #ad7175. The observed value survives as color.border.control and color.icon.decorative.

siteSpecific.--bar-height: i3 bar geometry; not a cross-application token
siteSpecific.--gap: i3 gap between tiles (3px); the spacing scale does not include it
siteSpecific.--gaps-inner: i3-gaps inner 14; window-manager behaviour, not theme
siteSpecific.--gaps-outer: i3-gaps outer -2; window-manager behaviour, not theme
